name: ui-forge
description: A VS Code integrated D2C agent for React projects.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @ui-forge/shared-protocol && npm run build -w @ui-forge/agent-core && npm run build -w @ui-forge/d2c-agent && npm run build -w @ui-forge/d2c-storage && npm run build -w @ui-forge/mastergo-adapter && npm run build -w @ui-forge/design-system-adapter && npm run build -w @ui-forge/component-indexer && npm run build -w @ui-forge/tools && npm run build -w @ui-forge/visual-evaluator && npm run build -w @ui-forge/eval-runner
scripts.build:apps: npm run build -w @ui-forge/agent-server && npm run build -w @ui-forge/agent-webview && npm run build -w @ui-forge/vscode-extension
scripts.check: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run test
